_: Alias OnActivate demo — a script attached to a quest ALIAS (alias[].script), not a base object, so it works on a ref CREATED at runtime. Chain: cast the Forge Hatch spell -> MFSE_SpellTrigger -> Fire(MFSE_HostKW, caster) -> SM starts MFSE_AliasHost, whose Chest alias uses createObject to SPAWN a chest (Skyrim.esm:0x0BCD2D, a vanilla small chest) at the Caster. That Chest alias carries the MFSE_AliasActivate script (extends ReferenceAlias). OPENING the spawned chest fires OnActivate -> Fire(MFSE_AliasKW, opener, chest) -> SM starts MFSE_AliasTarget. The whole point: no base-object script could touch that chest (it didn't exist at design time) — the alias script does. In-game: player.addspell the Forge Hatch spell, cast it (a chest appears at your feet), open the chest, then `sqv MFSE_AliasTarget` -> Running with Opener filled.

magicEffects.name: Forge Hatch
magicEffects._: Token self-heal so OnEffectStart runs on the caster; the payload is the attached MFSE_SpellTrigger.

quests.name: Forge Hatch Host
quests._: Started by the SM ScriptEvent root when MFSE_HostKW fires (the spell). Caster = event ref1 (the player). Chest uses createObject to materialize a vanilla small chest AT the Caster, and carries the MFSE_AliasActivate alias script — activating that spawned chest fires MFSE_AliasKW. The createObject target (Caster) must be a ref-type alias.

quests.name: Forge Hatch Target
quests._: Started by the SM ScriptEvent root when MFSE_AliasKW fires (opening the spawned chest). Opener = event ref1 (the activating actor), Chest = event ref2 (the chest). Verify: `sqv MFSE_AliasTarget` -> Running, Opener alias filled.
